result.markdown:
# Sluggish Data in Grand Tunis Due to Microwave Link Degradation

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** transport_degradation at `LNK-TUN-02-C`
- **Confidence:** medium (Major LINK_DEGRADED alarm timing fits KPI onset, and changes were checked and ruled out.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-11 18:45 to 2026-09-11 23:54
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-11 18:47
- **Affected:** S-TUN-006, S-TUN-011, S-TUN-014

## Summary

Transport degradation on shared microwave link LNK-TUN-02-C caused traffic drops and latency spikes across three downstream sites in Grand Tunis.

Three sites experienced sluggish data and latency spikes from 18:45 to 23:45 on 2026-09-11.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-11 18:00: Routing policy update performed on aggregation router. [CHG-2026-0026]
- 2026-09-11 18:45: Traffic drops and latency spikes begin on three sites in TUN. [ALR-0010]
- 2026-09-11 18:47: Major LINK_DEGRADED alarm raised on microwave link LNK-TUN-02-C. [ALM-000191]
- 2026-09-11 23:54: LINK_DEGRADED alarm clears on LNK-TUN-02-C. [ALM-000191]
- 2026-09-11 23:45: Traffic and latency anomaly alert ends. [ALR-0010]

## Evidence

- Sites S-TUN-006, S-TUN-011, and S-TUN-014 share the microwave link LNK-TUN-02-C. [T2, T3, T4]
- A major LINK_DEGRADED alarm occurred on LNK-TUN-02-C starting at 18:47 and clearing at 23:54. [ALM-000191]
- An alert for traffic drops and latency spikes on the three sites lasted from 18:45 to 23:45. [ALR-0010]
- No maintenance window was scheduled on the affected nodes or their parents. [T8]

## Hypotheses

1. **transport_degradation** at LNK-TUN-02-C: confirmed. Major LINK_DEGRADED alarm timing closely matches the onset and recovery of the traffic anomaly across all dependent sites. [ALM-000191, ALR-0010]
2. **bad_change** at AGG-TUN-02: rejected. The configuration change on AGG-TUN-02 preceded the degradation, but the transport link alarm provides the direct signature. [CHG-2026-0026, ALM-000191]

## Ruled out

- CHG-2026-0026: Routing policy update occurred before the link degradation and did not correlate with the transport alarm signature.
- ALM-000193: VSWR_HIGH minor alarm occurred hours later on 2026-09-12 and did not overlap with the evening incident.

## Recommended actions

- Inspect microwave link LNK-TUN-02-C hardware and path fading logs.
- Monitor modulation stability on LNK-TUN-02-C.

## Sources

- `CHG-2026-0026`: config_push on AGG-TUN-02 at 2026-09-11 18:00: Routing policy update on AGG-TUN-02
- `ALR-0010`: ended alert from 2026-09-11 18:45: 3 site(s) (S-TUN-006, S-TUN-011, S-TUN-014); metrics: dl_volume_mb, latency_ms
- `ALM-000191`: major LINK_DEGRADED on LNK-TUN-02-C, raised 2026-09-11 18:47, cleared 2026-09-11 23:54
- `T2`: get_topology(node_id=S-TUN-014, include=ancestors) -> Depends on (child -> parent -> core): S-TUN-014 (site) -> LNK-TUN-02-C (microwave link) -> AGG-TUN-02 (agg router) -> CORE-UPF-01 (core upf)
- `T3`: get_topology(node_id=S-TUN-006, include=all) -> Depends on (child -> parent -> core): S-TUN-006 (site) -> LNK-TUN-02-C (microwave link) -> AGG-TUN-02 (agg router) -> CORE-UPF-01 (core upf)
- `T4`: get_topology(node_id=S-TUN-011, include=all) -> Depends on (child -> parent -> core): S-TUN-011 (site) -> LNK-TUN-02-C (microwave link) -> AGG-TUN-02 (agg router) -> CORE-UPF-01 (core upf)
- `T8`: get_maintenance(start=2026-09-11 16:00, end=2026-09-12 08:52, node_ids=['LNK-TUN-02-C', 'AGG-TUN-02', 'S-TUN-006', 'S-TUN-011', 'S-TUN-014'], include_ -> No maintenance window scheduled on LNK-TUN-02-C, AGG-TUN-02, S-TUN-006, S-TUN-011 +1 more and its parents between 2026-09-11 16:00 and 2026-09-12 08:52.
- `ALM-000193`: minor VSWR_HIGH on S-TUN-014, raised 2026-09-12 04:11, cleared 2026-09-12 04:19

report.title: Sluggish Data in Grand Tunis Due to Microwave Link Degradation

confounders.why: Harmless config_push on AGG-TUN-02 45 min before the degradation; the sibling links under the same router were unaffected.

truth.notes: trap=change_on_root_node; Rain fade on microwave link LNK-TUN-02-C: throughput limited, sites stayed up. Trap: a config_push on AGG-TUN-02, the router above the link, ran 45 min before the degradation, so a hasty investigator blames the router change. Settled by: (1) only the sites of LNK-TUN-02-C degraded, while the sites of LNK-TUN-02-A, LNK-TUN-02-B under the same router stayed normal, so a router change is not the cause; (2) the KPIs were normal between the change and the onset; (3) the major LINK_DEGRADED alarm is on the microwave link, whose signal fluctuates like weather rather than stepping; (4) it recovered without any rollback.
